exposure: type of fish consumed (based on DHA and mercury content)
cohort: Pregnant women admitted for delivery in the last 6 months of 2023
finding: Consumption of small-size oily fish with high DHA and low mercury content was associated with increased neonatal weight and head circumference, and lower risk of gestational diabetes, gestational hypertension, and cesarean section.
mod_finding: Consumption of small-size oily fish with high DHA and low mercury content was associated with a lower risk of cesarean section.
